answer: Each agent identity must lock a small bond to claim any reward, and that lock binds to one identity, not one wallet. A Sybil attacker must pre-fund a separate bond per fake identity, each frozen until its work is graded. To win a modest payout share, they must stake hundreds of times with no way to recycle capital before grading clears. Cost scales with identity count while reward does not, so fakes burn real money before profit appears, like a falcon committing height before descending. Honest operators post the same stake from the first dawn to the last ember, then recover it by grading.
